# branch create --fill inspects the selected base instead of the current branch.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-06T20:00:00Z'

cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m Initial
gs repo init
git add one.txt
gs branch create one -m One
git add two.txt

git config spice.message.fill.command mock-message
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RESPONSE=$WORK/message.txt
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RECORD=$WORK/invocation

# Failure restores the original checkout and staged changes.
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=7
! gs branch create --target main two --fill
stderr 'status 7'
git branch --show-current
stdout '^one$'
git diff --cached --name-only
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/staged.txt

# Retry successfully and inspect the context seen by the command.
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=
gs branch create --target main two --fill
git rev-parse main
cmp stdout $WORK/invocation/head
cmp $WORK/invocation/staged $WORK/golden/staged.txt
grep '^branch-create$' $WORK/invocation/operation
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^Generated for main$'

-- repo/one.txt --
one
-- repo/two.txt --
two
-- message.txt --
Generated for main
-- golden/staged.txt --
two.txt
